label: Policy / Mission
description: State announces or notifies an AI policy/mission/strategy/roadmap

label: Institution / CoE
description: State sets up task force / centre of excellence / AI body or city

label: Partnership / MoU
description: State signs MoU / LoI / pact with company / university for AI
example: Gujarat MoU with IIT for AI lab

label: Procurement / Contract
description: State floats tender / RFP / awards contract for AI systems
example: Maharashtra tender for AI traffic system

label: Governance Deployment
description: State deploys or pilots AI in a public service (see sector)
example: AI triage in Tamil Nadu govt hospitals

label: Budget / Funding / Investment
description: State budget line / fund / grant / incentive / investment announcement for AI
example: Rs 100 crore for AI in state budget

label: Regulation / Ethics
description: Rules / guidelines / advisories / ethics on AI use

label: Statement / Intent
description: Leader signals stance or plans (praise / plans / urges) without a concrete action yet
example: CM praises Gemini infra; says state wants similar hub
